backSections.heading: Our Mission
backSections.body: We make advanced photonic computing accessible to datacenter operators and transceiver vendors, enabling extreme-efficiency optical signal processing at scale. By applying neural-network-inspired photonic circuits to critical bottlenecks in modern infrastructure, we unlock a new era of energy-efficient, high-performance 6G systems.

backSections.heading: Core Competence: Photonic Neural Computing
backSections.body: LUXONNIC's Photonic Neural Processor (PNP) applies recurrent neural architectures and learned nonlinearities directly in the optical domain. Unlike static FFE or DSP-based solutions, our approach combines the speed and energy efficiency of photonics with the adaptability of machine learning.

backSections.heading: Why It Matters
backSections.body: Datacenter transceivers account for ~60% of the €15.7B global transceiver market by 2030. Equalization is a core energy bottleneck. Our 30x efficiency gain directly reduces transceiver power consumption, hyperscaler carbon footprint, and infrastructure costs, making next-generation networks economically and environmentally viable.

quote: LUXONNIC emerged from research at Fraunhofer HHI on photonic neural networks and optical signal processing. The founders identified a critical gap: datacenter transceivers rely on power-hungry DSP-based equalization, creating a bottleneck for hyperscalers scaling 400G and beyond infrastructure. The company bridges this gap by applying recurrent neural network-inspired photonic circuits to the equalization problem, delivering 30x energy efficiency gains while maintaining performance. This application takes fundamental photonic research into the highest-volume, most cost-sensitive optical market: short-reach datacenter interconnects.
